intent: Dark, luminous daily health summary: three gradient activity rings that draw in, lap past 100% into a deeper shade and isolate on tap, over glass metric cards and a gliding week selector.

layout.header: uppercase date line over a 34pt 'Summary', 40pt initials avatar in a gradient ring
layout.week: glass bar, 7 columns (letter + 30pt mini rings), gliding glass pill, future days disabled
layout.rings: 264pt box, stroke 22, gap 3, padding 6; centre readout: micro label (TODAY or weekday), 34pt value + muted suffix, sub line
layout.legend: 3 columns: swatch, label, 19pt value in ring colour with muted goal; doubles as ring buttons
layout.cards: Steps (flex 1.18, sparkline) + Heart (flex 1, beat line); Sleep full width with stacked stage bar and 4-column key

motion.ringsDrawIn: after 280ms, stagger 140ms, 1250ms + 250ms per lap, ease-out; dash offset on an SVG mask
motion.overshoot: second lap in a deeper gradient; the tip dot's colour is interpolated from progress to match the arc, with a glow and a forward shadow onto lap one
motion.daySwitch: pill spring 500/40; rings ease from current to new values (820ms, 0.65,0,0.35,1, stagger 70ms); numbers tween; sparkline redraws; sleep segments re-flex
motion.isolate: others dim to 10% and scale 0.985 (spring 300/34), a halo in the ring's colour fades in around the rings, label crossfades with 5pt rise, value tweens to %
motion.ambient: heart comet travels the ECG path at the resting rate
motion.press: spring to 0.90–0.97, release with a single small overshoot
motion.reducedMotion: values set instantly, beat line static, crossfades instant
motion.glassFade: fade BlurView, sheen, content and edge individually; an ancestor with opacity < 1 cuts backdrop blur off on the web

responsive.width: 360–430pt; rings fixed at 264pt, centred; cards flex; week columns divide the bar width

accessibility: week days are tabs with selected and disabled state
ring area is a button whose label reads all three values; legend columns are buttons with selected state
sleep bar has a spoken summary of every stage

content.today: Friday, 9 October: Move 612/540 kcal (113%), Exercise 38/30 min, Stand 9/12 hr; 8,412 steps, 6.1 km; resting 59 bpm (52–148); slept 6h 52m (in bed 23:12–06:41)
content.week: Mon 5 – Sun 11 October; Saturday and Sunday are future and disabled

avoid: one linear gradient on a full circle (it seams)
flat translucent grey cards with no blur
rings that redraw from zero on every day switch
